question: Should TOOL_PROGRESS_KIND and isToolProgressPayload become the supported public plugin SDK contract for cross-plugin progress intent?
rationale: The fix requires a shared Codex-to-Slack signal, but the scoped SDK policy treats every new export as a lasting third-party contract and no maintainer approval of this specific API direction is present.

options.title: Approve the generic SDK contract
options.body: Keep the owner-neutral reply-payload marker and predicate after the native-block defect and exact-head proof are addressed.

options.title: Keep the marker internal
options.body: Replace the public exports with a narrower bundled-runtime seam if third-party plugins should not depend on progress-intent metadata.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic SDK contract
recommendation.body: Keep the owner-neutral reply-payload marker and predicate after the native-block defect and exact-head proof are addressed.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows ownership of the affected Slack native-data path and broader plugin SDK surface reductions.
